
# Project Instructions

## Project Overview
- This is a Java Maven project.
- The application is called Tic Tac Twist.
- It is a futuristic twist on conventional Tic Tac Toe.
- Players can use special abilities and spells during gameplay.

## Before Making Changes
- Always inspect the existing project structure before modifying code.
- Understand the existing classes, methods and dependencies.
- Reuse existing implementations wherever possible.
- Do not assume a class or method exists without checking.

## Coding Standards
- Follow Java naming conventions.
- Use meaningful class, method and variable names.
- Follow object-oriented programming principles.
- Keep methods small and focused.
- Avoid unnecessary code duplication.
- Write readable and maintainable code.

## Architecture
- Keep business logic separate from presentation logic.
- Avoid putting the entire application inside one class.
- Use appropriate classes and interfaces.
- Follow the existing architecture rather than introducing a new one unnecessarily.

## Dependencies
- Use Maven for dependency management.
- Check pom.xml before adding new dependencies.
- Avoid introducing unnecessary external libraries.

## Testing
- Add or update tests when implementing new functionality.
- Run the relevant tests after making changes.
- Fix existing test failures caused by your changes.

## AI Agent Rules
- Explain your proposed approach before major architectural changes.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Do not delete existing functionality without permission.
- Ask for clarification when requirements are ambiguous.
- Summarize all modified files and explain the changes after completing a task.
